second_method.method: printed BLUE PRINT difficulty table total (Easy 12 + Average 3 + Difficulty 1 = 16), pdf 38; independently, the answer side's keys counted

count_gate.note: Question side labels 1-16 monotonic, no gaps, no duplicates (I 1-3, II 4-7, III 8, IV 9-12, V 13-16); answer side keys 1-16 in order (T/F keys 1-3 printed in one sentence-run '1 is correct, 2 is incorrect, 3 is incorrect.'; key section labels III/IV are the question side's IV/V). BLUE PRINT 12/3/1 = 16 = audited count. Difficulty per question: easy 0, average 0, difficult 0, untagged 16.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 38 (heading 'Unit -9', LO 4, BLUE PRINT, q1-4) 39 (q5-13) 40 (q14-16). A side 'Key Answers. :- Unit 9 Pretty house' pdf 110 (keys 1-16 + the q8 picture). Folios = pdf page.

BILINGUAL: all Kannada dropped (Unicode both sides; one key line on pdf 110 has a legacy-Nudi glyph run — dropped). q15 stem prints a stray combining mark after 'house' (font artefact) — removed from text, kept in text_as_printed.

Sections: s1 I T/F q1-3 (keys 'N is correct/incorrect' -> true/false, printed words in answer_as_printed); s2 II q4-7 (q4 three lettered points A/B/C -> sa, 3 steps; q5-7 one sentence/list -> vsa); s3 III q8 draw -> sa; s4 IV match q9-12 (numbered rows -> one-pair match questions); s5 V fill q13-16.

MARKS (R-E9, control rev 3): s5 '4x1 = 4' (4 q) -> 1. Null + unassigned + ambiguity flag where N disagrees with the printed count (factors reversed): s1 '1 X 3=3' over 3 q, s2 '2 X 4=8' over 4 q, s3 '4 X 1=4' over 1 q, s4 '1x4 = 4' over 4 q.
DIFFICULTY: none printed -> null + 'no difficulty tag'. quota_table difficulty_only; second method = BLUE PRINT total 16 (agrees). LO (R-E10): lesson LO 4, lo_source 'lesson_table'.

ANSWER FIGURE (v1.4 §14.10, crop-first): the answer side prints a line drawing of a house under '8. Picture of the house.' (pdf 110, the only image on the page) -> crop committed first (Staging 00ef9cc), referenced as answer_diagram asset a8 (bare draw-diagram shape, soc-9-14 q38); value = the printed text; flag 'answer is a diagram' (not blocking). The drawing carries a stock website watermark (noted in caption).
KEYS: match key 10 'to protect from sunlight' vs column B 'to protect from sun light' flagged; q4 key printed with lettered points A./B./C. kept in the steps.
